name: liquid-glass-notification

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the top notification expanded with its photo while the second card stays readable.

tagline: A glass notification stack blooms open to reveal a photo.
summary: Two stacked glass notifications sit at the bottom of a photo backdrop, each with an app icon, title, message and time. Hovering or clicking the top one expands it from a slim row into a card with a preview image.
appearance: Two slim dark glass cards stacked with a small gap, each showing a rounded gradient app icon, a bold title, one or two lines of white text and a time at the right. When open, the top card grows tall and reveals a mountain lake photo beneath its text.
behaviour: At rest the notifications are slim rows. Pointing at or clicking the top card expands it downward with a spring to reveal the preview image, then it shrinks back. The lower card stays compact throughout.
demo_content: Two alerts, one from UI-Layouts, both reading New components are available for you, with a mountain lake photo.
search_phrases: push alerts on a photo background
use_when: You want a rich notification that can open to show an attachment or preview without leaving the page.
avoid_when: The expanded card is a fixed 410px wide, and the preview is a hardcoded remote image.
customise: Titles, messages, timestamps, icon gradients and the preview image URL are hardcoded in the JSX. Size, blur, shadow, glow and the expandable flag come from the glass card props.
weight_why: Two blurred glass cards with a displacement filter and a remote preview image.

a11y.note: Expanding relies on pointer hover or click on a div with no keyboard focus, so keyboard users cannot open it.

issues: The second app's title is an SVG wordmark that renders as an unreadable blob at this size.
The preview image loads from a remote URL, so the expanded card can show a gap offline.
polish_why: Convincing frosted rows and a smooth expand; the second title is illegible.
